title: Per Diem Shortfall Calculation for Closing and Funding Closings
content:
**Formal clause.** A per diem shortfall is the prepaid interest a borrower still owes on a funded Closing and Funding closing whose charge collected at closing was priced below the per diem the note supports, and the borrower pays it on their own instruction. For a per diem shortfall, the charge collected at closing is the closing's prepaid interest charge booked on the signing date. A shortfall that comes only from funding earlier than estimated is never collected, so a day before the first day of the charge collected at closing never counts toward a per diem shortfall.

1. **Daily amount of every other entry.** Every prepaid interest entry other than a per diem shortfall payment or a funding-month interest payment, the charge collected at closing included, keeps the per diem policy's daily amount: the closing's loan amount times its note rate taken as a percent, divided by the per diem day-count basis, rounded to the per diem rounding decimals.
2. **Shortfall per diem.** The shortfall per diem, which prices a per diem shortfall only and never funding-month interest, is the loan file's loan amount times the rate the closing's lock holds, taken as a percent, divided by the per diem day-count basis of the closing method, rounded half up to the cent.
3. **What the closing holds.** The prepaid interest the closing holds for a per diem shortfall is the charge collected at closing less, for every late-funding refund that names it, the refunded days times the charge's daily amount; interest Larkspur added to a refund for booking it late is not part of what the closing holds.
4. **Shortfall days.** In the standard measure, the shortfall days are every day of the charge collected at closing.
5. **Shortfall.** The per diem shortfall is the shortfall days times the shortfall per diem less the prepaid interest the closing holds, rounded half up to the cent and never below zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| loan file's loan amount | 400,000.00 |
| rate the lock holds | 6.5 percent |
| per diem day-count basis | 365 |
| charge collected at closing | the 26th through the 30th, 5 days, daily amount 69.86 (the closing record's 400,000.00 at a note rate of 6.375 percent, divided by 365), amount 349.30 |
| late-funding refunds naming the charge | none |

- Shortfall per diem: 400,000.00 times 6.5 percent, divided by 365, is 71.2329, rounded to 71.23.
- Held: 349.30 (no refund names the charge).
- Shortfall days in the standard measure: 5.
- Shortfall: 5 days times 71.23 is 356.15; less 349.30 gives a per diem shortfall of 6.85.

If the same charge had carried a late-funding refund of 2 days, the closing would hold 349.30 less 2 times 69.86, which is 209.58.
